name: FractalAI Agent Passport
description: Verifies ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS 204) signed receipts and agent passports offline against a pinned key, and exposes pay-per-call x402 tools (USDC on Base) that return ML-DSA-65 signed receipts. Unpaid calls to paid tools return the x402 payment challenge.

FRACTALAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the FractalAI web endpoints.

FRACTALAI_RPC_URL.description: FractalAI JSON-RPC node URL used for agent registry lookups.
